items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: Dave Atholomew had already told me... we gonna do like, and it's his words, we gonna do like Arthur Prysock and Buddy Johnson with Arthur Prysock.

ctx.x: Now my record came out doing fantastic.

Louisiana, all in the south, in the southern market. Now Dave Atholomew had already told me, said, man, well look up, we gonna do like, and it's his words, we gonna do like Arthur Prysock and Buddy Johnson with Arthur Prysock. You see, in the record back then, Arthur Prysock's name was up in the right hand corner as a singer, Buddy Johnson was out here. So this is what Dave said, it was gonna do with me. So when the record came out, the people didn't look at who was singing, they look at Dave Atholomew. Okay,…
